name: security-inventory-reservation-state-review
intent: Inventory reservation ownership, expiry and allocation transitions
artifacts: Reservation token/owner, stock counter, expiry worker and checkout commit/release logic.
trace: Follow reserved units through confirm, expiry and cancellation; check whether a caller can confirm another reservation or obtain allocation twice.
experiment: Use a tiny local stock fixture with two owned customers; compare rightful confirmation with stale/foreign reservation and inspect allocation state.
disproof: A reservation accepted by the UI is not a fulfilled allocation; documented overbooking must be distinguished from the asserted invariant.
repair: Bind reservation owner and atomic stock transitions, testing expiry/confirm ordering with deterministic local barriers.
branch_decisions: Separate stock reservation from final allocation and fulfillment. The expiry-versus-confirm order should be deterministic in the local fixture. A restored reservation counter with an uncommitted checkout proves no extra allocation; deliberate oversell/backorder policy must be documented before asserting conservation.
operational_method: Write the owned state table: available stock becomes held on reserve, held becomes allocated on confirm, and held returns to available on expiry/release. Under a no-oversell fixture, available+held+allocated stays equal to initial stock; adapt for documented backorders. Schedule confirm versus expiry deterministically, then repeat release delivery and inspect authoritative counters/allocations. A UI stock label or a rejected confirmation is not extra fulfillment.
